notes.title: Update and other things
notes.content:
Hello! ːpeekː

I've just finished one of the scenes for the upcoming update, and thought "this might be a good time for a news post", so here goes...

One thing I want to make clear right from the start: I still don't know when the update will be done, but it shouldn't take too long anymore.

So, as many of you know, I've been back in my home country for a few weeks, settle some things, get the last bits and pieces of my stuff, etc.. most of my stuff comes with a container ship in one or two months, but I took some hardware from my old render pc with me (so I won't have to wait for it to arrive with the container), and I'm already using it effectively. Render times have decreased a lot!

Anyway, I know most of you just want to know about the update:
Currently there are 7 scenes more or less finished. There are scenes for all of the girls (side, and main), and the main story progresses as well. I'm still working on some render and animations for some of them, but they're mostly done.
I still have to do one bigger scene and some minor scenes in between, to connect everything, but after that, there's only testing and the beta release, which usually takes about two weeks, after that the full update will release.

I should mention that I've decided to not switch to WS after this update, but to go right back to BM. The way I've planned things out, it makes more sense to keep working on BM. I could, of course, just release one huge update, but there's just so much left to do, that I prefer to not do that.
Nonetheless, this update should still be the biggest to date (content wise).

I'm also planning to release a SFW version of BM (Steam only), which requires some additional work, but it shouldn't affect the update much. This will make it possible to release BM in countries where Lewd stuff is not available on steam, but with a small (free) patch, it can be converted back to NSFW.

So yeah, that's all for now. Stay tuned for more soon 😉

notes.title: Beta Channel and updates
notes.content:
[b]Hello lovely people![/b]
First of all, I want to officially announce that there is a beta channel for the game which includes several fixes, but no new content for now. Yes, the beta channel has been there for a while, but I've never officially announced it, so here is the announcement for that ːpeekː

Second is a question to the community here.
[i]But this needs a little explanation first:[/i]
I release updates on several platforms, but Steam has one big advantage over most of the others, I can push updates through the steam Api.
The Api looks at the files, looks which of them are new, which have changed, and then only uploads those new, or changed files. On most other platforms the game is available on, I have to upload the full game with every update, or have to workaround some obstacles which makes it a pain in the A... to update.

Until now I've always updated the game on all platforms at the same time.
Now I could, in theory, push smaller updates here on steam, but there are a few caveats.
- First of all, obviously the updates would be smaller, probably one scene at a time.
- The updates would only be for the beta branch. The non-beta will still only get the big updates as usual.
- There won't be a lot of testing, so there might be game breaking bugs, save incompatibilities, or things that change until the big update.
- It involves some extra work. Not only for publishing the update. For example, to save time I usually make sure all scenes end and jump to where they're supposed to jump when I'm almost done with the full update, so the game won't just end mid-scene, or in a undesirable spot, I also add stuff I've left out for whatever reason before, change things if necessary... but when I do smaller updates I'll have to do most of that before every small beta update, and there will probably still be small changes with the big updates.

On the positives:
- Faster updates.
- You get to see new content before everyone else.
- Less complaints about long update times (well, this one is probably mostly positive for me, haha).

So let me know what you think, would you like to get small betas, or do you prefer one big, and properly tested update.
I'll decide depending on the comments here.

Have a good one ;)

notes.title: Update coming soon!
notes.content:
Yep, it's getting closer.

The Beta will be available some time in May for patrons/subscriber in Tester/Stalker tier and up. It will be availabe for one to two weeks, depending on the feedback and necessary fixes.

I'm currently at 583 render, so already more than I had expected, and I'm still not entirely sure how much more it will be, but 600 should be easy^^
Depending on how the beta goes, I might do some additional animations or render, but we'll see how it goes ;)

[b]For those of you that don't follow the community posts here, and as a reminder to everyone else:[/b]
I'm using a different animation technique now, which I had to learn how to use, so the first one and a half months or so (all of january and a good part of february), I did basically just testing and practicing.
I'm still not entirely happy with the results, but I'm at a point where they're good enough so I don't feel bad to include the animations in the game anymore.
(I might add one or two of my early attempts in the special gallery, so you have something to laugh about)
Why am I telling you this?
Well it means two things: the time I had for the update wasn't as long as it looks from the outside, which means there won't be as much content as in the last update, but it also means animations will be easier and therefore faster to create from now on.

[i][b]For those of you interested in testing the beta, PLEASE READ![/b][/i]
First and most importantly:
-When I say Beta, I mean it! I know a lot of studios and/or devs see betas as some kind of promotion material, but this isn't the case here.
[b]There will be bugs and there will be stuff missing[/b], this may or may not include: render, animations, full scenes and/or paths/routes.
-I still haven't found the time to get access to the beta channel here on steam, so for now the beta will only be accessible for patreons/subscriber on the Tester/Stalker tier and up.
-The download will only be available on my official discord server, and you'll have to link your patreon/subscribestar account to discord to be able to access the channel.
[i]I know this is quite the hassle, but it's mainly to prevent early leaks and to reduce the workload and time I rather spend on finishing the update.[/i]

Stay tuned!

notes.title: This thing on?
notes.content:
First things first:
[h3][b]A big Thank you to everyone who supported and still supports me here on Steam and everywhere else![/b][/h3]
Also thanks to everyone for taking part in the community and for all the positive feedback so far!

The release went quite smooth, no big surprises here, but a few people seem to have a problem with the animations not running smoothly, this seems to be a renpy issue (the engine I'm using) and will be fixed with the next release. If you don't want to work that long, there is a workaround that seems to work for most players:
Open the game, hit Shift + G, in the new window turn off "Power Saving" and turn on "Force ANGLE2 Renderer", disable Tearing if it's enabled, that's it.
As I said, this works for most people, but some had to switch to another renderer and for some people nothing worked at all, they'll sadly have to wait for the update :(

I've read a few comments from people being concerned about Ellie's look, so first thing I'd like to mention is that she's definitley 18 and also meant to look like that (while also meant to look extremely cute), if you think she looks too young then I'd suggest to go out and see a few 18 y.o. girls, and I don't mean these girls with 20tons paint on their faces, you might notice that some look younger than others, while some also look older, my niece for example is 22 and looks younger than Ellie.

Then there are some people complaining about the game being too short...
I mean... I don't know, did you see the "Early Access" tag? Also seeing some barely even reached 2 hours play time, did you try other routes? I know that not every route is for everyone, so no offense, but if you don't follow Kat's and/or Jada's route for example, then you miss a lot content.

Regarding the update I can't give a date yet, I want to have a specific amount of content ready before I release it, I'm also awaiting some new hardware that should speed things up, but it also makes it harder to predict any date.
I'm hoping to be able to release the update within the next two months.
On the technical side there's a lot of the stuff meant for the update already exclusively in the steam version, but there will some more coming. One example is changeable in-game music.
A russian and a portuguese fan-translation are on the way as well.
Of course there will be new content, the story will progress, we will finally be able to date Hanna, get closer to Rachel, and there might also be a big surprise... :P

Well, that's it for now, thanks for your attention.

Don't forget that you can join my [url=https://discord.gg/QkrKJTt]discord[/url] if you want to get latest news, teasers and update status of Bad Memories, or if you just want to take part in the community. There's also some extra stuff for patrons/subscriber ;)

Have a good one!
~rec
